filters.title: Brightness gap
filters.text: The two greens differ too much in total brightness.

filters.title: Lopsided
filters.text: One green is much smaller than the other.

filters.title: Dim
filters.text: A segment barely stands out from its surroundings.

filters.title: Red impure
filters.text: Too much green inside the red.

filters.title: Misaligned
filters.text: Bent, red off the line between the greens, or across the fibre.

filters.title: Stubby
filters.text: Too short for its width, or with gaps along its length.

filters.title: Green impure
filters.text: Too much red inside a green.

filters.title: In nucleus
filters.text: The red lies mostly on a cell nucleus (DAPI).

filters.title: Overlap
filters.text: Shares its red, or much of a green, with a stronger NoR.

filters.title: Faint
filters.text: Its red is among the dimmest of this image's NoRs.

one green.title: Unpaired
one green.text: Only one green touches the red.

greens joined.title: Joined greens
greens joined.text: The two greens touch and form one blob.

not in a line.title: Misaligned
not in a line.text: Bent, red off the line between the greens, or across the fibre.

red impure.title: Red impure
red impure.text: Too much green inside the red.

green impure.title: Green impure
green impure.text: Too much red inside a green.

greens unequal.title: Lopsided
greens unequal.text: One green is much smaller than the other.

not stick-like.title: Stubby

shares a segment.text: Shares its red, or much of a green, with a stronger NoR.

red not rectangular.text: The red is not a compact bar.

help.green_frac: Share of the image's pixels that may count as green (the brightest ones). Raise it to pick up fainter paranodes.
help.red_frac: Share of the image's pixels that may count as red (the brightest ones). Raise it to pick up fainter nodes.
help.smooth: Blur (pixels) before pixels are sorted into green and red. 0 = none; blur smears red into green.
help.min_red: Smallest red blob kept, in pixels.
help.min_green: Smallest green blob kept, in pixels. Also decides which blobs set the unit.
help.touch: A green must come this close to the red, in pixels, to belong to it.
help.reach_u: A green segment is cut off this far from the red centre (units).
help.rim: Pixels next to the other colour left out when purity is measured, since blur makes that rim yellow.
help.smooth_u: Blur (units) used to find peaks and directions. More blur merges nearby spots.
help.nms_u: Two peaks closer than this (units) count as one.
help.strip_u: Half-width (units) of the strip walked along the fibre.
help.touch_u: A green counts as touching the red if it comes this close (units).
help.angle_step: Degrees between the directions tried when looking along the fibre.
help.bend: Largest bend (degrees) allowed on each side of the node.
help.half: A blob is coloured in down to this fraction of its own peak brightness.
help.own_side: Colour each green only on its own side of the red.
help.comb_u: Size (units) of the patch used to measure which way the fibre runs.
help.comb_window: Directions tried lie within this many degrees of the measured fibre direction (90 or more = all).
help.fg: Nothing dimmer than this many colour levels is coloured in.
help.valleys: Stop colouring at a dip between two green hills, so one green cannot swallow its neighbour.
help.valley_depth: How deep a dip must be (in colour levels) to split two hills.
help.min_area_u2: Smallest red kept, in square units.
help.min_green_u2: Smallest green kept, in square units.
help.snap_u: Distance (units) the landing spot may move to reach the true peak.
help.green_dom: A pixel is coloured green only where green is at least this many times the red.
help.d_u: Distances (units) tried between the red window and each green window.
help.n_ang: Number of angles the stencil is turned to.
help.s_min: How well all three windows must match (in colour levels) for a spot to become a candidate.
help.dip: If above 0, the midpoints between the red and each green window must be lit too (no dark gap). 0 = off.
help.g_reach_u: A paranode stops this far (units) from where it meets the red.
help.g_weak: Below 1, the fainter green window may be dimmer than the other two and still match fully.
help.red_steps: Brightness levels (fractions of the red peak) the red is grown down to, one by one.
help.min_rect: How rectangular the red must stay while growing. 0 = off.
help.max_perim: How ragged the red's outline may get while growing. 99 = off.
help.g_low: Faintest green hill (in green levels) that can still be a paranode.
help.red_dom: Trim the red to pixels where red outshines green.
help.trim: When two NoRs overlap, let one give up the tip of a green the other owns.
help.far_u: When only one side has green, look this far (units) for the missing paranode. 0 = off.
help.far_cone: Half-width (degrees) of the cone searched opposite the known green.
help.gap_level: The line from the red to that far green must stay this bright (colour levels).
help.blue: 'post': nuclei are removed after finding (the page's way). 'pre': blanked before finding.
help.multi: Try every pair of greens around a red, not just the first found.
help.split: Split a green hill that touches the red on two sides.
help.nucleus_rule: 'red': a NoR is in a nucleus when its red is. 'all': judged on all its pixels.
help.strip: Half-width (pixels) of the strip walked along the fibre.
help.seed_smooth: Blur (pixels) before red peaks are picked as starting points.
help.seed_nms: Two red starting points closer than this (pixels) count as one.
help.band_u: Half-width (units) of the band a green must sit in.
help.hyst: Keep walking while the colour stays above this fraction of its threshold.
help.min_green_balance: The weaker green must be at least this fraction of the stronger one.
help.min_snr: The dimmest of the three segments must stand this many noise levels above its surroundings.
help.purity: Largest share of a segment's pixels that may be lit in the other colour.
help.min_opposite: The angle green-red-green must be at least this straight (degrees; 180 = a straight line).
help.max_off_u: Largest distance (units) of the red from the line between the greens.
help.max_axis_dev: Largest angle (degrees) between the NoR and the fibre direction.
help.min_aspect: Length over mean width must be at least this: a NoR is a stick, not a round blob.
help.min_solid: Share of the line along the NoR that must be covered by the NoR itself (1 = no gaps).
help.nucleus_frac: A NoR is rejected when at least this share of its red lies on a nucleus (the blue mask).
help.red_floor_q: A NoR is rejected when its red is dimmer than this share of the image's NoRs (0.1 = the dimmest tenth; 0 = off).
help.max_shared: A NoR is rejected as a duplicate when a stronger NoR already owns its red, or more than this share of either green.

help.multi: Try every pair of greens around a red, not just the first found.
help.split: Split a green hill that touches the red on two sides.
help.nucleus_rule: 'red': a NoR is in a nucleus when its red is. 'all': judged on all its pixels.
help.strip: Half-width (pixels) of the strip walked along the fibre.
help.seed_smooth: Blur (pixels) before red peaks are picked as starting points.
help.seed_nms: Two red starting points closer than this (pixels) count as one.
help.band_u: Half-width (units) of the band a green must sit in.
help.hyst: Keep walking while the colour stays above this fraction of its threshold.
help.min_green_balance: The weaker green must be at least this fraction of the stronger one.
help.min_snr: The dimmest of the three segments must stand this many noise levels above its surroundings.
help.purity: Largest share of a segment's pixels that may be lit in the other colour.
help.min_opposite: The angle green-red-green must be at least this straight (degrees; 180 = a straight line).
help.max_off_u: Largest distance (units) of the red from the line between the greens.
help.max_axis_dev: Largest angle (degrees) between the NoR and the fibre direction.
help.min_aspect: Length over mean width must be at least this: a NoR is a stick, not a round blob.
help.min_solid: Share of the line along the NoR that must be covered by the NoR itself (1 = no gaps).
help.nucleus_frac: A NoR is rejected when at least this share of its red lies on a nucleus (the blue mask).
help.red_floor_q: A NoR is rejected when its red is dimmer than this share of the image's NoRs (0.1 = the dimmest tenth; 0 = off).
help.max_shared: A NoR is rejected as a duplicate when a stronger NoR already owns its red, or more than this share of either green.

filters.title: Brightness gap
filters.text: The two greens differ too much in total brightness.

filters.title: Lopsided
filters.text: One green is much smaller than the other.

filters.title: Dim
filters.text: A segment barely stands out from its surroundings.

filters.title: Red impure
filters.text: Too much green inside the red.

filters.title: Misaligned
filters.text: Bent, red off the line between the greens, or across the fibre.

filters.title: Stubby
filters.text: Too short for its width, or with gaps along its length.

filters.title: Green impure
filters.text: Too much red inside a green.

filters.title: In nucleus
filters.text: The red lies mostly on a cell nucleus (DAPI).

filters.title: Overlap
filters.text: Shares its red, or much of a green, with a stronger NoR.

filters.title: Faint
filters.text: Its red is among the dimmest of this image's NoRs.

help.green_frac: Share of the image's pixels that may count as green (the brightest ones). Raise it to pick up fainter paranodes.
help.red_frac: Share of the image's pixels that may count as red (the brightest ones). Raise it to pick up fainter nodes.
help.smooth: Blur (pixels) before pixels are sorted into green and red. 0 = none; blur smears red into green.
help.min_red: Smallest red blob kept, in pixels.
help.min_green: Smallest green blob kept, in pixels. Also decides which blobs set the unit.
help.touch: A green must come this close to the red, in pixels, to belong to it.
help.reach_u: A green segment is cut off this far from the red centre (units).
help.rim: Pixels next to the other colour left out when purity is measured, since blur makes that rim yellow.
help.smooth_u: Blur (units) used to find peaks and directions. More blur merges nearby spots.
help.nms_u: Two peaks closer than this (units) count as one.
help.strip_u: Half-width (units) of the strip walked along the fibre.
help.touch_u: A green counts as touching the red if it comes this close (units).
help.angle_step: Degrees between the directions tried when looking along the fibre.
help.bend: Largest bend (degrees) allowed on each side of the node.
help.half: A blob is coloured in down to this fraction of its own peak brightness.
help.own_side: Colour each green only on its own side of the red.
help.comb_u: Size (units) of the patch used to measure which way the fibre runs.
help.comb_window: Directions tried lie within this many degrees of the measured fibre direction (90 or more = all).
help.fg: Nothing dimmer than this many colour levels is coloured in.
help.valleys: Stop colouring at a dip between two green hills, so one green cannot swallow its neighbour.
help.valley_depth: How deep a dip must be (in colour levels) to split two hills.
help.min_area_u2: Smallest red kept, in square units.
help.min_green_u2: Smallest green kept, in square units.
help.snap_u: Distance (units) the landing spot may move to reach the true peak.
help.green_dom: A pixel is coloured green only where green is at least this many times the red.
help.d_u: Distances (units) tried between the red window and each green window.
help.n_ang: Number of angles the stencil is turned to.
help.s_min: How well all three windows must match (in colour levels) for a spot to become a candidate.
help.dip: If above 0, the midpoints between the red and each green window must be lit too (no dark gap). 0 = off.
help.g_reach_u: A paranode stops this far (units) from where it meets the red.
help.g_weak: Below 1, the fainter green window may be dimmer than the other two and still match fully.
help.red_steps: Brightness levels (fractions of the red peak) the red is grown down to, one by one.
help.min_rect: How rectangular the red must stay while growing. 0 = off.
help.max_perim: How ragged the red's outline may get while growing. 99 = off.
help.g_low: Faintest green hill (in green levels) that can still be a paranode.
help.red_dom: Trim the red to pixels where red outshines green.
help.trim: When two NoRs overlap, let one give up the tip of a green the other owns.
help.far_u: When only one side has green, look this far (units) for the missing paranode. 0 = off.
help.far_cone: Half-width (degrees) of the cone searched opposite the known green.
help.gap_level: The line from the red to that far green must stay this bright (colour levels).

help.split: Split a green hill that touches the red on two sides.
